run_hitl_main: run the HITL main entry point with an app config to start a headed or headless Habitat app
run_hitl_headed_main: run the headed HITL main loop with a GLFW window, renderer, and LabDriver or SimDriver
run_hitl_headless_main: run the headless HITL main loop with a mock renderer and HeadlessTextDrawer for no-display execution
run_headless_app_loop: run the headless application loop that steps simulation updates, records debug video frames, and tracks SPS
parse_debug_third_person: parse the debug third-person viewport config to compute width and height from the HITL config
